ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels with a localized distribution of high-intensity (white) pixels; estimated 80:20 black-to-white pixel ratio on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white mottling is concentrated along the peripheral trailing edges and distal tips of both lobes; the central areas and region proximal to the peduncle are characterized by uniform low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 35 degrees; depth is significant, dividing the lobes cleanly.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth serrations along the continuous boundary; a prominent deep secondary notch is visible on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending to the distal tips, characterized by significant jagged non-linearities along the entire trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of irregular circular pixel groups located at both distal tips; clusters exhibit multi-tonal white and reddish-brown pixel values.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation and structural irregularities at the extreme distal tips; distinct irregular notch/trauma on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of reddish-brown high-contrast pixel clusters at the tips, distinct from the primary black and white fluke pigmentation.
